scope: One prepared Steam Deck; actual Windows AGain and Serum 2.0.18. SDK observations exclude DAW compensation and audio devices. Moonlight connected for control.

units.timing: nanoseconds; percentile values are logarithmic bucket upper bounds
units.cpu: percent of one logical CPU; owner includes Python and Proton services
units.delay: frames; vendor latency is zero in all completed setups

limitations: Short focused runs, not reliability guarantees.
Submitted-note count does not establish vendor internal polyphony.
Before 9532e0e, negative_correlated_residuals also counts completed-but-unpublished stop-boundary requests; stage sample counts reveal missing publication. Final code separates this field.
Owned-process CPU subcounts include only processes present in both snapshots; cgroup total includes the whole owned cohort.
Original failed attempts remain failed, even where process exit was zero.
